Description: Caster (on a clear night, when stars are visible) gains perfect directional and distance sense. For the duration of this spell, he will always know where he is in relation to known landmarks
Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. The caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of 4 hours) for this spell to work)
Gives a general idea of the place of origin of an item
Caster knows whether a text is cursed, what language it is in, and other general information; but only understand basic concepts of it
Gives a vision of a significant event in the item's past
As Dreams I, except limit is 2 dreams per night on different topics
As Dreams I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics
Caster receives (usually from his patron deity) a "yes" or a "no" to a question on a single topic. This spell may be used a maximum of once per day
As Origins, but caster gets clear vision of the location of origin of an item, including creator and approximate date
As Commune I, except caster receives answers to three questions
As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams per night on any combination of topics the caster chooses
As Commune I, except caster can receive a more detailed answer (e.g., a name or short phrase) to a question involving only 1 concept

As Dream I, except caster is able to manipulate his dream in a limited way to gain more information on a specific topic. For example, while he is in the dream he can ask a question (but there is no guarantee it will be answered)
Caster receives detailed information from his deity on a single topic question. SPECIAL NOTES See Section 7.1.2 for more on dreams and symbology in divination. HOLY VISION
